object.description: Setup: paired strap, session recording; a screen recording or stopwatch is available. Steps: 1. Move the strap out of range or switch it off for 2 min. 2. Note how long each signal lost status shows on the Active screen before Searching replaces it. 3. Bring the strap back. Expected: The status changes to signal lost; each signal lost status lasts at most 30 s, and Searching may then stay until the strap returns; after step 3 a bpm appears without user action.
